quotes.text: We just finished our third day this week with these guys and have our 4th day booked. It honestly does not make sense owning a boat with these boys around. Best service, knowledge, equipment, and prices. If you are even remotely considering heading out on the water don't hesitate.... These guys book up quick!!

They were the highlight of our trip! The whole experience was amazing, a ton of fun and a wonderful experience for my family. The boat was really nice, the staff was very polite and experienced at teaching us to wake boarding and they made it a lot of fun!
Had a great time with y'all for our wake surf lesson! Great tips and lots of encouragement from your team, looking forward to another surf when you get to Skaha lake!!
The boat is amazing, the surf wave was even better. My brother, dad and I had an amazing time this afternoon! Thanks again!
